# Synthetic SVG fixtures for the importer

These are written by hand for Gertie's tests. They imitate the markup habits of design tools (Inkscape metadata and `style` attributes, Figma-style `fill="none"` roots and gradient ids, Illustrator `Layer_1` and CSS classes). They are **not** real exports from those tools. The real third-party files are in `examples/import/third-party/`.
